$comment: Every fixture with the schema it must validate against (schemas/<schema>.schema.json) and the HTTP status it is served with (for request bodies, the status of the answer). In request, {origin} is the instance origin, {index_url} is directory.index_url and {cursor} is any earlier next_cursor.

fixtures.description: A listed instance with a ping key.
The operator turned listing off: the directory block stays but listed is false. Not listed.
An instance that never enabled listing: no directory block. Not listed.
Every indexable place in one page, ordered by id. Rust Help has a category, child boards and a nested sub-board.
A first page of two places. After Dark, whose id sorts between them, is NSFW and is skipped, so the page still holds two indexable places.
First page of the Beginners board, ordered by updated_at then id.
Second and last page of the Beginners board.
First page of a solved topic with replies; post 3 replies to post 2.
Last page. Post 4 (01a12cfd-9a20-7a7b-8127-e7affc8c47c7) is by a user who excluded their posts, so the numbers jump from 3 to 5. Post 5 is edited and is the solution.
A topic that fits on one page.
A pinned, locked topic without replies.
An unsolved topic opened by gopher (see changes-user-exclude.json).
The opening post is by quietfox, who excluded their posts. The topic is not indexable even though replies remain, and is answered exactly like a missing one.
A feed page with more events to come.
A coalesced feed: seq has gaps where earlier events for the same object were replaced by later ones.
No events and a cursor for the current end of the feed, taken at the start of a reconcile.
The cursor is older than retained history. The indexer reconciles and resumes from cursor=latest.
The board Reverse proxies moved from Homelab to Self-Hosting: a board.delete for the old place, then a board.upsert for the new one, with the same board_id.
The file topic moved from Beginners to Advanced: one topic.upsert carrying the new board_id. The indexer re-reads the topic.
gopher excluded their posts: user.exclude, then topic.delete for the topic whose opening post is theirs. Their replies elsewhere are dropped through user.exclude.
gopher included their posts again: user.include, then a topic.upsert for every topic with a post of theirs.
Forward compatibility: an event type this version does not define. Consumers skip it and keep the cursor moving.
Sent with a Retry-After header, which the client honors.
A ping body. See signing-vector.json for the headers. Answered 202 with no body.
A ping whose signature does not verify.
Register an origin. Answered 201 with registration-response.json.
A new registration is pending until it passes the quality gate.
The well-known check failed; detail names the check. Nothing is stored.
